answers.core: Theoretically, it is possible to implement this as a plugin, but it will still require major changes to the editor code. Also, if it comes out of the box, it will greatly simplify the use of the engine.
answers.workaround: This feature will be useful for any teams that want to work effectively together. This cannot be worked around with a few lines of code.

title: Add the possibility of multi-user editing of projects over the network
